datasets.title: New Caledonia: High Resolution Population Density Maps + Demographic Estimates
datasets.description: The world's most accurate population datasets. Seven maps/datasets for the distribution of various populations in New Caledonia: (1) Overall population density (2) Women (3) Men (4) Children (ages 0-5) (5) Youth (ages 15-24) (6) Elderly (ages 60+) (7) Women of reproductive age (ages 15-49).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/new-caledonia-high-resolution-population-density-maps-demographic-estimates]
datasets.details: To reference this data, please use the following citation: Facebook Connectivity Lab and Center for International Earth Science Information Network - CIESIN - Columbia University. 2016. High Resolution Settlement Layer (HRSL). Source imagery for HRSL © 2016 DigitalGlobe. Accessed DAY MONTH YEAR.' Please note that as of 2024, Meta's high resolution population density maps are no longer being updated.

lineage.description: High-resolution population density maps were produced by applying machine learning techniques to commercial satellite imagery to detect building footprints across New Caledonia. These footprints were then used in partnership with Columbia University to spatially disaggregate census-derived population estimates into gridded raster outputs at high resolution. The resulting datasets provide demographic breakdowns (overall, gender, age groups) suitable for exposure analysis in disaster risk assessments.

sources.name: AI and Data for Good at Meta (Facebook)
sources.description: Machine learning models applied to commercially available satellite imagery to identify building footprints, used as the spatial basis for disaggregating population estimates.

sources.name: Columbia University
sources.description: Provides population disaggregation methodology overlaying general population estimates from publicly available census data onto the building footprint layer.
